events.title: Share Your Own Fate Tips by Hero Event!
events.description:
Celebrate The Call of Chaos Season 2 Update by participating in the Share Your Tips Event!
• From new and returning Heirs taking their first steps into The Call of Chaos, to veteran Heirs carrying their experience from Season 1!
• Please share your own special “Fate Selection by Hero” tips so everyone can enjoy The Call of Chaos even more!

events.title: "Dirge of the End: Rewind" Event Notice
events.description:
Special benefits to prepare for the story ahead!
• A support event will be held to help Heirs complete Episode 6, "Dirge of the End."
• Players can earn Leif by clearing the Episode.

events.title: Bunny Girl Maid Cecilia’s Daily Life of a Palace Maid Special Event
events.description:
A palace maid with an indifferent gaze! Bunny Girl Maid Cecilia’s Daily Life of a Palace Maid event begins!
• To celebrate the release of Bunny Girl Maid Cecilia, a special event for Daily Life of a Palace Maid will be held.
• You can enter the event by going to Lobby > Event > Special Event > Secret Rabbit♥Hole.

events.title: Event Dungeon, "Emergency Mission! Catalyst Search" Open
Pick the Best Shorts of E7WC 2026! (Week 3)
events.description:
The fierce competition of E7WC 2026 continues!
• With the tournament nearing its end, the Grand Final is finally here.
• Are you ready to cheer along, Heirs?

events.title: Epic Road Special Event
events.description:
The Epic Road event begins, bringing the fun of earning rewards day by day!
• Complete missions and use the event currency, “Faint Guiding Stone,” to receive various rewards!
• Players can receive rewards using Faint Guiding Stones obtained through Epic Road event missions or from the Record of the Journey Attendance Book.

events.title: Great Detective's Daily Investigation & Lucky Board Party! Event
42-Day Journey! ‘Record of the Journey’ Check-In Event
events.description:
A chance to receive rewards just by logging in every day!
• We’re here with news regarding the 42-day-long “Record of the Journey” Check-In Event.
• We’ve prepared even more valuable and plentiful rewards the more consistently you participate, so don’t forget to visit every day and complete your precious Record of the Journey.

events.title: STEAM Official Launch & New Server "Foundry" Opening Celebration Event Notice
events.description:
Along with details about the Steam launch and the new server opening, we have prepared various benefits, including growth support events to help you on your journey on the new server.
⟦d.efReq|All Heirs on the Foundry server who log in to Epic Seven during the event period⟧
• If you wish to continue playing on Steam using your existing account data, please convert your account in advance through the official STOVE website before accessing Steam.
• For instructions on how to convert your account, please refer to the FAQ Steam-related FAQ (Link) .

events.title: E7WC 2026 Predictions Event
events.description:
Spice up the E7WC 2026 with the Predictions Event!
• Who will be the champion to let out the cheer of victory after passing through the fierce Tournament Stages and Finals?
• Predict the results with your keen insight and claim great rewards!
